drafted_from: tool:fetch-free-sound-effects-with-their-licences row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Download the sound effects I chose in /work/sfx/selection.json, reading each licence first, into /work/sfx/sfx with a manifest." It runs the fetcher and tells you how many were kept, blocked and unavailable.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads selection.json and the two candidates files on this computer, downloads files into a folder and writes a manifest.json.
instructions: 1. Run tool:search-freesound-for-free-sound-effects and tool:search-mixkit-for-free-sound-effects to get fs-candidates.json and mk-candidates.json.
2. Write /work/sfx/selection.json: {"tick": [["freesound", 1], ["freesound", 2], ["mixkit", 9]]} (category, then [library, id] pairs taken from the candidates).

3. Say "Download my chosen sounds". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/fetch_free_sound_effects.py /work/sfx/selection.json /work/sfx/fs-candidates.json /work/sfx/mk-candidates.json /work/sfx/sfx /work/sfx/manifest.json

4. Read the last line (kept, blocked, unavailable) and manifest.json: each entry has its page, author, title, licence as read, licence_seen, local file, and blocked or unavailable with the reason. A file already kept is not fetched again.

worked_examples.title: A CC0 sound and a Mixkit sound are kept; a NonCommercial one is blocked; a missing file is unavailable
worked_examples.ask: Download the four sounds I chose and keep their licences.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_fetch_keeps_allowed_licences_only_and_says_why_not, made-up pages): selection.json is {"tick": [["freesound", 1], ["freesound", 2], ["mixkit", 9], ["mixkit", 8]]}. Freesound item 1's page says Creative Commons 0; item 2's page says Attribution NonCommercial; Mixkit 9 serves a WAV; Mixkit 8 answers HTTP 404. Command: python3 -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/fetch_free_sound_effects.py /work/sfx/selection.json /work/sfx/fs-candidates.json /work/sfx/mk-candidates.json /work/sfx/sfx /work/sfx/manifest.json
worked_examples.hands_back: It prints "tick: freesound-1 CC0 1.0 -> fs-1_tick-one.mp3", "tick: freesound-2 BLOCKED Attribution NonCommercial", "tick: mixkit-9 Mixkit Sound Effects Free License -> mk-9_click.wav", "tick: mixkit-8 UNAVAILABLE HTTP 404", then {"result": {"manifest": "/work/sfx/manifest.json", "kept": 2, "blocked": 1, "unavailable": 1}}. manifest freesound-2 has file null and blocked "licence Attribution NonCommercial (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) is not CC0 / CC BY".
